title: Baby in Infant Seat on Couch, 1961 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white family snapshot captured in March or April 1961 featuring an infant sitting securely strapped into an early-style wire-and-fabric infant bouncy seat propped against a textured upholstered living room sofa. The baby is dressed in a light-colored outfit and knit booties, grasping a small bell rattle. The image reflects mid-century American baby boom culture and family domestic life, complete with scalloped deckle edges typical of period photo processing.
